name: 🍕 Pizza Party
what: Everybody stretches their own pizza, sauces it, tops it, and bakes it on a hot pan.
early: 1 hour before: take the dough out of the fridge so it stretches easily.

core.name: Pizza dough
core.out: pizza crust or naan for a 10-minute version

extras: grated parmesan, oregano, garlic powder, hot honey for the grown-ups

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside.
Cut the dough into 4 balls. Press and stretch each one thin on a floured counter.
Spread a little sauce on each, leaving a border. Cheese, then pepperoni.
Slide onto the hot pan (parchment is easiest). Bake until the crust is deep golden and the cheese bubbles.

key: Heat the pan in the oven first. A hot pan gives a crisp bottom.
done: Crust is deep golden and the cheese is bubbling.
plan_b: Dough won't cooperate? Make naan pizzas: same toppings, 8 minutes.
